head.text: WF-015 OP-014 Interrupt cause through raw, enable, injection and masked status (success)

foot.text: APB clock, cause tx_und from a real transmit underrun. The cause is set while masked; enabling it raises the output; a write of 1 clears the raw bit; an injection (its rising edge) sets it again; a clear while the injection bit is still high clears it and it stays clear.
